text:
DJIA Market Happenings For Wednesday, December 26, 2018 Posted by admin on December 26th, 2018
There are no Dow stocks at 52 week highs. Dow stock 52 week lows include Apple (AAPL), Chevron (CVX), DowDuPont (DWDP), Goldman Sachs (GS), Home Depot (HD), IBM (IBM), JPMorgan (JPM), 3M (MMM), Travelers (TRV), United Technologies and Exxon Mobil (XOM). That’s eleven (11) Dow stocks with new lows.
The Market
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open up +146 points.
Tuesday the Dow was down -653.17 (-2.91%) at 21,792.20.
Year-to-date the Dow is down -11.84%.
There were no Dow stocks up Tuesday.
The Dow stock winners Tuesday were not to be found.
The Dow stock losers Tuesday were led by Nike (NKE) -5.90%, Microsoft (MSFT) -4.17%, Johnson & Johnson (JNJ) -4.10%, Procter & Gamble (PG) -3.97%, United Technologies (UTX) -3.88% and Exxon Mobil (XOM) -3.83%.
European stocks are mostly lower and Asian markets ended mostly lower.
The national average price of gasoline is down three-tenths of a cent at $2.310 per gallon.
Earnings Reports .
There are no Dow stocks set to release earnings in the near term.
Today’s Featured Dow Stock
Goldman Sachs (GS)
Goldman Sachs (GS) is down -38.63% year-to-date.
